_doc: Guns and missiles (openspec/changes/weapons-and-shields sections 1, 4 and 6; coop-drill design 2.3-2.4). A gun's bolt leaves at speed_mps plus its ship's velocity. sigma_rate_k is degrees of aim error per degree per second of the target's angular rate across the line of sight. A turret fires only when its hit chance is at least min_hit_chance. Each bolt puts heat_per_bolt_mj into its turret's sink, which sheds heat_shed_mw; at heat_sink_mj the turret locks out until it is below heat_resume_frac of it (weapons-and-shields 2). The heavy pulse's shedding is a placeholder that matches its capacitor-limited rate, so the Hound's threat is what it was.
